feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Trump administration proposes new tariffs on goods from major U.S. trading partners
entry.summary: President Trump's new proposed tariffs are already meeting pushback from Democrats and some free trade advocates.

entry.title: Sen. Tim Kaine, D-Va., shares why he opposes Trump's proposed tariffs
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez speaks with Virginia Sen. Tim Kaine about the Democrat's opposition to President Trump's new tariffs.

entry.title: At Albuquerque's Indian Pueblo Kitchen, Native American dishes are the main course
entry.summary: At an Albuquerque, N.M., museum, the restaurant is just as much of a draw as the exhibitions, with dishes like green chile stew and sweet biscochitos flavored with anise and cinnamon.

entry.title: 'Memories of a Good Meal': How food made a difference during WWII
entry.summary: New Orleans Chef Alon Shaya's new cookbook shares stories of resilience from World War II, centered around food.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Severe weather dampens Thanksgiving travel, Trump administration proposes new tariffs on major U.S. trading partners, EPA testing for lead contamination after Iowa munitions detonation.

entry.title: A dish with a story, Thanksgiving with culinary historian Michael Twitty
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel welcomes culinary historian Michael Twitty into her kitchen for a Thanksgiving cooking session on making Kush, the forerunner to Southern cornbread dressing.

entry.title: Court lets Puerto Rico governor fire firm that runs the island's troubled power grid
entry.summary: LUMA Energy took over the electric grid five years ago. The court's ruling nullifies its contract, and gives the government a year to find a new operator.

entry.title: Former FBI negotiator on how to de-escalate tension at your Thanksgiving table
entry.summary: What can we learn from a retired FBI crisis negotiator about being the calmest person at the Thanksgiving table?

entry.title: More people searched for news during the midterms, survey finds
entry.summary: Most Americans sought out information about the results of the midterm elections. A Pew study found that younger and older adults turned to very different sources.

entry.title: Powerful storms disrupt holiday travel, as Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is postponed
entry.summary: Extreme weather that has unleashed strong winds, high tides, heavy rain and floods is expected to impact travel plans of an estimated 81.5 million people as they travel across the United States.
